ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme: A deeper dive
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including the individuals and organizations involved, and the impact on Minnesota's daycare industry.
questions: Who was involved in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme?
What was the extent of the fraud?
How did the scheme impact Minnesota's daycare industry?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme is a prime example of the need for greater oversight and regulation in Minnesota's daycare industry.
